setup.scope: This market covers finished watches (mechanical, quartz, and smart/hybrid timepieces) sold as consumer or luxury goods, valued at the point of final sale to end users. It excludes watch components, movements, straps, and repair services as separately valued markets, and excludes non-watch wearables such as fitness bands and laser therapy devices. Demand for watches is derived from consumer spending, gifting, and fashion/status consumption; component and accessory demand may be used as an intermediate signal for watch production volumes but is never priced as part of this market.

setup.scope: This market covers watches as finished timekeeping products valued at the point of consumer purchase, including mechanical, quartz, and smart/hybrid watches sold under watch brands, whether sold through physical retail, brand boutiques, or online channels. Excluded are watch components and parts (movements, cases, straps, crystals) sold separately as B2B inputs, repair and servicing revenue, and non-watch wearables that lack a primary timekeeping function (e.g., fitness bands without a watch form factor). Also excluded are second-hand/resale transactions, which are not newly valued production, and licensed merchandise that is not a functioning timepiece. Where smartwatch demand is used as evidence, only the watch-form-factor portion counts toward this market's volume.
